Tobe Jansson Akebono Children's Forest Park is surrounded by metasequoia (dawn redwood) trees and is a popular spot for viewing fall foliage. Peak foliage typically occurs around late November each year.

Updates on foliage conditions will be shared on this page and the park's official social media accounts (Instagram, X, and Facebook).
